one_line: The world grows slowly on a mandatory tick. The user steers a little, documents a lot, and cannot undo what has grown.

core_laws.LAW_TICK: Evolution advances ONLY on the tick. The user cannot rush, skip, or rewind the tick. Growth is the engine's, not the user's.
core_laws.LAW_APPEND_ONLY: Nothing that has grown can be deleted, edited, or reverted. A dragon, once locked into the lineage, is permanent. (This is the append-only camera, enforced.)
core_laws.LAW_STEER_NOT_AUTHOR: The user injects directional pressure BEFORE a tick resolves. They influence what MIGHT grow next. They never author the result directly.
core_laws.LAW_NEW_GAME_ONLY: The only way to 'undo' is to start a new lineage (new game). An existing lineage is read-only history.
core_laws.LAW_DELIVERABLE_IS_THE_IMAGE: The product is the render (photo/video) of a state. The simulation exists to PRODUCE photographable states, not to be managed.

disclaimer_shown_at_start: This is a slow simulation. Your dragons grow on their own, on a timeline you cannot speed up. You may gently steer what grows next — but once something has grown, it is permanent. You cannot delete it, edit it, or change its past. You document; you do not control. To begin again, start a new lineage.

tick.resolution: On each tick, at most ONE pending injection resolves into a new locked node, OR the world holds (no growth this tick). Holding is normal and expected — slowness is the point.
tick.note: Tick cadence is a tuning value, intentionally long. The voyeuristic feel depends on the user NOT being able to fast-forward.

node_schema.comment: Every dragon is a node in the lineage graph. This is the unit the renderer photographs and the unit the map plots.
node_schema.parents: array[node_id]  (0 for seed, 1 for age/trait, 2 for breed)
node_schema.locked: boolean  (only locked nodes count for lineage, render, and map)
node_schema.genome_ref: string  (points to the canon genome / invariant kernel)
node_schema.visual_anchor_ref: string  (the Anchor Vector that keeps identity recognizable across renders)

map_position.comment: MAPPABILITY. Every node gets deterministic coordinates so the lineage IS a map with no extra work.
map_position.x: float  = generation (time axis, left to right)
map_position.y: float  = lineage_lane (which bloodline branch, top to bottom)
map_position.derivation: Coordinates are computed from graph position, never hand-placed. A new node's (x,y) is fixed the instant it locks.

render_state.ceremony: enum [birth, elder_rite, territorial_clash, call_to_action, dormant]  (the FRAMING for the photo, not a simulated event)
render_state.render_ref: string  (points to compositor output once photographed)

injections.comment: The CLOSED v1 set. Exactly three moves. Each is lock-gated. A wide menu is v3; v1 stays narrow so every result renders beautifully and consistently.

BREED.produces: one descendant node carrying both parent lineages
BREED.lock_gate: Descendant must pass canon lock (genome compatible, no illegal cross-class traits). If it fails, NO node is created and the tick holds.
BREED.map_effect: New node placed at generation = max(parents)+1, on a lane between the two parent lanes.

AGE_ADVANCE.produces: a new node, SAME identity, advanced life stage — NOT a replacement (append-only; the prior stage persists)
AGE_ADVANCE.lock_gate: Anchor Vector must be preserved (same recognizable dragon). If identity drift exceeds tolerance, reject and hold.
AGE_ADVANCE.map_effect: New node placed adjacent on the same lineage lane, one generation step along the time axis.

TRAIT_PRESSURE.produces: a new adapted node — same dragon, environment-shifted visual state (your Evolution Engine logic: pressure -> adaptation -> visual output)
TRAIT_PRESSURE.lock_gate: Adaptation must be biologically coherent for the genome (no aquatic lungs + volcanic respiration). Reject illegal combos and hold.
TRAIT_PRESSURE.map_effect: New node branches off the subject's lane as a sub-branch.

what_the_user_CANNOT_do: edit a locked node's genome, anatomy, or history
rewind or replay a past tick
directly author a result (they steer pre-tick; the engine resolves)
force growth (the world may hold a tick with no change)
manage resources, traffic, conflict outcomes, or 'win/lose' states — there are none
what_the_user_CAN_do: queue ONE injection before a tick (breed / age / trait-pressure)
photograph any locked node, in any available ceremony framing (image or video)
collect renders into their lineage gallery (the trophy wall)
let the world simply grow and watch / document
start a NEW lineage at any time (the only reset)

deliverables_per_node.image: compositor render of the node in chosen ceremony framing
deliverables_per_node.video: short loop of the node (the A/B video spec you already build)
deliverables_per_node.map: the lineage graph, auto-plotted from node map_position values — the user's 'territory'

handoff.comment: How this plugs into what you already have.
handoff.to_lineage_spine: A locked node here = a locked descendant in the thin spec. DEPTH/ORIGIN/RARITY (and therefore VALUE) are computed from this graph directly.
handoff.to_compositor: render_state.render_ref points at fge_compositor.py output. The contract decides WHAT to photograph; the compositor decides HOW.
handoff.to_canon: lock_gate in every injection IS the compile->validate->lock lifecycle. No new lock machinery needed.

map_is_free: Because map_position is computed from generation (x) and lineage lane (y) at lock time, the lineage graph is a map with zero extra authoring. You said map deliverables are hard for you — this contract makes the map a byproduct of growth, not a thing you draw.
